message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large white serif letters. Above the title, smaller yellow text reads "WAWANCARA" followed by a small square inset photograph of a man with glasses and a beard, and "UMBERTO ECO". Below the title, text reads "EDISI 24-30 Oktober 2011". Large yellow sans-serif text in the center reads "Opera Sabun Kocok Kabinet".

The central figure is a man seen from behind, wearing a blue suit. He has many arms extending from his torso. One pair of arms is raised; the right hand holds a thin baton. Two arms extend sideways with open palms. Another hand on the left holds a white quill pen. A hand on the right holds a silver-topped cane. Two hands are tied behind his back with a red rope. He stands before a row of six massive, smooth white columns. A barcode, price "Rp 27.000", and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN" are at the bottom. Small vertical text on the left margin includes "ISSN: 0126 - 4273" and a website URL.
